reject.nativeXray: This JSON profile contains Xray settings; choose Auto or Xray to keep its route.
reject.xrayTransport: The transport settings require Xray; choose Auto or Xray.
reject.noXrayClient: Xray has no {{protocol}} client: this server runs only on sing-box. Choose «Auto» in the connection settings or sing-box for this server.
reject.xrayForm: Xray cannot run {{protocol}} with the transport or TLS of this profile. Choose «Auto» in the connection settings or sing-box for this server.
reject.amneziawg: This is an AmneziaWG server: neither sing-box nor Xray can run it, and plain WireGuard would not reach it. It needs the mihomo engine, a lab feature this build does not run.

singBoxOnly.h2Transport: The profile uses features Xray does not have (HTTP/2 transport); choose Auto or sing-box.
singBoxOnly.quicTransport: The profile uses features Xray does not have (QUIC transport); choose Auto or sing-box.
singBoxOnly.insecureWithoutPin: The profile uses features Xray does not have (certificate checks disabled without a pinned certificate); choose Auto or sing-box.
singBoxOnly.spkiPin: The profile uses features Xray does not have (certificate public key pinning); choose Auto or sing-box.
singBoxOnly.ech: The profile uses features Xray does not have (ECH with a DNS lookup of its config, over QUIC or with REALITY); choose Auto or sing-box.
singBoxOnly.shadowsocksPlugin: The profile uses features Xray does not have (Shadowsocks plugin); choose Auto or sing-box.
singBoxOnly.shadowsocksUdpOverTcp: The profile uses features Xray does not have (Shadowsocks UDP over TCP with a pre-2022 cipher); choose Auto or sing-box.
singBoxOnly.shadowsocksMethod: The profile uses features Xray does not have (Shadowsocks cipher); choose Auto or sing-box.
singBoxOnly.realityTransport: The profile uses features Xray does not have (REALITY over WebSocket or HTTPUpgrade); choose Auto or sing-box.
singBoxOnly.plaintext: The profile uses features Xray does not have (an unencrypted connection to a public server); choose Auto or sing-box.

conflict.h2Transport: The profile needs an Xray transport but also uses the HTTP/2 transport, which Xray does not support.
conflict.quicTransport: The profile needs an Xray transport but also uses the QUIC transport, which Xray does not support.
conflict.insecureWithoutPin: The profile needs an Xray transport but also disables certificate checks, which Xray does not support (to skip certificate checks, set pinnedPeerCertSha256 / pcs).
conflict.spkiPin: The profile needs an Xray transport but also pins the certificate public key, which Xray does not support.
conflict.ech: The profile needs an Xray transport but also uses ECH in a form Xray does not support (a DNS lookup of its config, QUIC or REALITY).
conflict.shadowsocksPlugin: The profile needs an Xray transport but also uses a Shadowsocks plugin, which Xray does not support.
conflict.shadowsocksUdpOverTcp: The profile needs an Xray transport but also uses Shadowsocks UDP over TCP with a pre-2022 cipher, which Xray does not support.
conflict.shadowsocksMethod: The profile needs an Xray transport but also uses a Shadowsocks cipher Xray does not support.
conflict.realityTransport: The profile needs an Xray transport but also uses REALITY over WebSocket or HTTPUpgrade, which Xray does not support.
conflict.plaintext: The profile needs an Xray transport but also uses an unencrypted connection to a public server, which Xray does not allow.

config.protocol: Xray does not support the {{protocol}} protocol.
config.invalid: The profile setting {{setting}} is not valid for Xray.

warn.stealth: Stealth mode does not apply on Xray: the TLS handshake is not fragmented and the fingerprint does not rotate.
warn.xhttpMux: Mux.cool was turned off for the XHTTP connection: XHTTP multiplexes connections itself.
warn.mux: Xray does not use the profile's multiplexing (sing-box mux).
warn.dial: Xray does not apply the profile's connection options (timeout, TCP Fast Open, MPTCP, UDP fragmentation, IPv4/IPv6 choice).
warn.singboxExtra: Xray does not apply the profile's extra sing-box options (for example TLS fragmentation).
warn.disableSni: Xray cannot hide the server name: the SNI is sent although the profile turns it off.
warn.fingerprintUnknown: Xray does not know the TLS fingerprint “{{fingerprint}}”; the default one is used.
warn.fingerprintRejected: Current REALITY servers (Xray 26.9.8 and newer) refuse the TLS fingerprint “{{fingerprint}}”; choose chrome, firefox or safari.
warn.fingerprintBroken: Most servers fail with the TLS fingerprint “{{fingerprint}}”; choose chrome, firefox or safari.
warn.earlyData: WebSocket early data is off: Xray sends it only in the Sec-WebSocket-Protocol header.
warn.packetEncoding: Xray chooses the VLESS UDP encoding itself; the profile's packet encoding “{{encoding}}” is not used.
warn.bbrProfile: Xray does not know the BBR profile “{{profile}}”; the default one is used.

resolve.failed: Could not resolve the Xray server address before starting the tunnel.
resolve.sinkhole: DNS returned a blocked address for the Xray server; the tunnel was not started.
resolve.poisoned: The DNS answers for the Xray server name were forged (it looks like blocking by the network) and no trustworthy DNS server could be reached; the tunnel was not started.
